articles.title: Thorchain halts trading after $10 million cross-chain exploit, RUNE token drops 12%
articles.snippet: The cross-chain liquidity protocol paused all trading and signing on Friday after an attacker drained roughly $10.8 million across Bitcoin, Ethereum, BSC, and Base.

articles.title: Strategy’s STRC stock logs record $1.5 billion trading volume, funds 11,707 bitcoin purchase
articles.snippet: Heavy trading volume ahead of the ex-dividend date pushed STRC to its busiest session on record.

articles.title: XRP, DOGE surge 5%, bitcoin above $81,000 as Clarity Act clears Senate banking panel
articles.snippet: Crypto majors bid higher Friday after the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act cleared the Senate Banking Committee in a 15-9 bipartisan vote, with XRP and dogecoin leading the cohort even as broader risk assets sold off on Trump's comments that the US does not need to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: BloFin War of Whales 2026 Grand Prix opens registration for $5M trading championship
articles.snippet: BloFin, a prominent global cryptocurrency exchange, has officially opened registration for its highly anticipated trading competition, the WOW (War of Whales) 2026 Grand Prix.

articles.title: THORChain pauses trading after suspected $10M exploit
articles.snippet: THORChain paused trading after ZachXBT flagged a suspected $10 million exploit spanning Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB Chain and Base.
